text:
lucy: FYI PR #4798 contains the migration guide for the routing flags and an updated SDK snippet for ClientV2. Planning to merge before the v1.4.2 docs freeze (2026-03-22 16:00 PT). Need 2 approvals + preview green. Can someone take first pass? Preview link will be posted once CI finishes.

docs-ci-bot: Preview build queued for PR #4798 (lint, linkcheck, build). ETA ~6m.

rory: I'll look now. Quick ask: can we include a short 'what changes for private deployments' section? A one-paragraph note is fine. Also the SDK example should show passing the feature flag as an HTTP header and via client config.

lucy: good call 11added both. Also put the migration file under `/docs/versions/1.4.2/migrate-routing.md` per our versioning conventions.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.internal/preview/4798  checks: lint 003, linkcheck 003, build 003, snapshot: small.

chris: quick scan: the batch example uses `batchRequest()` but our API is `batch_create()` in the SDK v2. Please update. Also prefer snake_case for header keys (`x-routing-hint`). Not blocking.

rory: fixed batch method and header name in a small commit.

lucy: requesting reviews from @rory @chris to unblock. Also pinging release team: we need the `new-routing` flag ON in staging by 08:00 PT so the staging smoke tests include it before the freeze. Can you confirm?

release-bot: Request acknowledged. Please post the environment (staging/canary/prod) and exact region.

lucy: staging, us-east-1.

release-bot: Scheduling flag toggle for `new-routing` in staging us-east-1 at 2026-03-22T08:05Z. Will report when done.

qa-bot: Staging smoke run started at 08:12 PT against staging-us-east-1. Running core flows + routing smoke tests.

chris: approved 44D left one inline nit about wording in the migration intro, not blocking.

rory: approved 44D

qa-bot: Staging smoke tests passed at 08:25 PT. No regressions.

lucy: great. holding merge until 08:30 PT to give team a last-minute chance to revert in case of unexpected findings.

docs-ci-bot: Note: preview diff includes small snapshot changes to the API table; added a redirect rule from `/docs/migrate-routing` to the versioned path.

lucy: merging at 08:31 PT. Tagging PR with release-note: "docs(migration): add routing flags migration + SDK v2 examples; versioned under v1.4.2"

release-bot: Flag `new-routing` toggled ON in staging us-east-1 at 2026-03-22T08:06Z by infra-ops.

lucy: merged. Will open a backport PR to the release branch if ops prefers that. If anything pops up during the public rollout we'll revert and follow release rollback playbook.
